095    public static byte[] buildCargo(long pumpTimeSec, long sequenceNum, int currentUserMode, int previousUserMode, int requestedAction, int sleepStartedByGui, int activeSleepSchedule, int exerciseStoppedByTimer, int exerciseChoice, int exerciseTime, int eatingSoonStoppedByTimer) {
096        return HistoryLog.fillCargo(Bytes.combine(
097            HistoryLog.typeIdBytes(229, 0),
098            Bytes.toUint32(pumpTimeSec),
099            Bytes.toUint32(sequenceNum),
100            new byte[]{ (byte) currentUserMode },
101            new byte[]{ (byte) previousUserMode },
102            new byte[]{ (byte) requestedAction },
103            new byte[1],
104            new byte[]{ (byte) sleepStartedByGui },
105            new byte[]{ (byte) activeSleepSchedule },
106            new byte[2],
107            new byte[]{ (byte) exerciseStoppedByTimer },
108            new byte[]{ (byte) exerciseChoice },
109            Bytes.firstTwoBytesLittleEndian(exerciseTime),
110            new byte[]{ (byte) eatingSoonStoppedByTimer }));
111    }
